description: Source code implementing UDP transport for the mcumgr SMP protocol in Zephyr OS, including socket creation, thread management, and network event handling.

methods.name: smp_udp_proto_to_name
methods.description: Converts protocol enum to human-readable name.

methods.name: smp_udp4_tx
methods.description: Transmits data over IPv4 UDP socket.

methods.name: smp_udp6_tx
methods.description: Transmits data over IPv6 UDP socket.

methods.name: smp_udp_get_mtu
methods.description: Returns the MTU size for UDP transport.

methods.name: smp_udp_ud_copy
methods.description: Copies user data (socket address) between buffers.

methods.name: create_socket
methods.description: Creates and binds a UDP socket for specified protocol.

methods.name: smp_udp_receive_thread
methods.description: Thread function to receive UDP packets and process SMP requests.

methods.name: smp_udp_open_iface
methods.description: Handles network interface up events to signal readiness.

methods.name: smp_udp_net_event_handler
methods.description: Handles network management events, such as interface up.

methods.name: create_thread
methods.description: Creates and starts a thread for UDP reception.

methods.name: smp_udp_open
methods.description: Initializes UDP transport, creates threads, and registers event callbacks.

methods.name: smp_udp_close
methods.description: Closes UDP sockets and aborts threads.

methods.name: smp_udp_start
methods.description: Configures and starts UDP transport, registers SMP handler.
